basis: Nikkoku 滝 [2] -> reading-specific たきすい【滝水】, the named historical sake; actual 酒 title 'alcohol; sake' and full article include alcoholic drink.

directions.alcoholSakeForWaterfall: The historical abbreviated drink sense can admit the broad alcohol/sake label, independently of other guards.
directions.waterfallRapidsForAlcohol: The primary displayed waterfall/rapids label does not mean alcohol. This is a conservative direct secondary-sense guard, not universal synonymy or an assertion that all alcohol is a waterfall.

scope: Append 酒 after 液 only on 滝; direct symmetric exclusion, no transitivity/counterpart edit. The historical abbreviated sense is not taught as modern/generic alcohol.
